translation: In the conditions of injury, oppression and pain of the chest and abdomen are mostly caused by leaping and jumping, striking the chest, spraining and misaligning, lifting heavy things, toil, and anger. If the chest and abdomen like to be touched by the hand, this is liver fire injuring the spleen (脾); use Four Gentlemen Decoction (四君子湯) with added bupleurum (柴胡) and gardenia (山梔). If one fears the hand touching, this is blood stasis of the liver channel; use Four Substances Decoction (四物湯) with added bupleurum (柴胡), gardenia (山梔), peach kernel (桃仁), and safflower (紅花). If there is oppression and pain of the chest and hypochondrium, with fever and afternoon heat (晡熱), this is injury to the blood of the liver channel; use Modified Free and Easy Powder (加味逍遙散). If there is oppression and pain of the chest and hypochondrium, with little desire for food and drink, this is injury to the qi of the liver and spleen; use Four Gentlemen Decoction (四君子湯) with added chuanxiong (芎), dang gui (歸), bupleurum (柴), gardenia (梔), and moutan bark (丹皮). If there is distension and fullness of the chest and abdomen, with little desire for food and drink, this is qi stagnation of the liver and spleen; use Six Gentlemen Decoction (六君子湯) with added bupleurum (柴胡), chuanxiong (芎), and dang gui (歸). If the chest and abdomen are not free, with little food and no sleep, this is binding and stagnation of the spleen qi; use Modified Spleen-Returning Decoction (加味歸脾湯). If the phlegm and qi are not free, this is qi stagnation of the spleen and lung; use Two Aged Decoction (二陳湯) with added atractylodes (白朮), chuanxiong (芎), dang gui (歸), gardenia (山梔), hemp (大麻), and uncaria hook (鉤藤鉤). If, because of excessive use of wind-heat medicines, the liver blood is injured and the liver fire becomes even more intense, or if one drinks sugar wine, then the kidney water (腎水) becomes even more deficient and the spleen fire becomes even more blazing; if one then uses rhubarb (大黃) and peony (芍藥) to injure the yin collaterals internally, it instead causes bleeding from below.
